Hi Anna — great to meet today. Quick recap + concrete asks so we have alignment on the security/compliance path for a Private/VPC or on‑prem option with Redwood. I captured the items we discussed and the suggested next steps below.

Call recap (high level):
- Environment target: private deployment (VPC peering or dedicated on‑prem appliance depending on procurement).
- Compliance scope: HIPAA applies to PHI in your workflows; GDPR controls apply to EU‑resident data (you noted a small EU client base).
- SOC 2: you mentioned SOC 2 in progress (Type II audit scheduled Q4).

Asks / evidence we need to qualify architecture and produce a proposal:
1) SOC 2 status: please share the current SOC 2 report/draft and expected completion date for Type II.
2) HIPAA/BA: confirm whether MedVerge requires a signed BA (yes/no) and who on your side owns that procurement.
3) Network sketch: a simple topology (CIDR ranges, required inbound/outbound connectivity, whether internet egress is allowed, any air‑gapped requirements).
4) Questionnaire kickoff: if you can start the attached vendor security questionnaire, we’ll fill the technical responses and highlight where Redwood provides controls.
5) Data residency: confirm preferred region(s) (you mentioned us‑east by default).

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- You: share SOC2 draft + network sketch + initial questionnaire answers (target by end of next week).
- Us: schedule a 60‑minute security deep‑dive (network + access + logging + key management) — propose Wed 9/22 or Thu 9/23.
- Karthik: he’ll follow up with an engineering checklist to help scope peering/on‑prem work.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (starter), Redwood_private-deploy-checklist.pdf (internal template — will attach after we align).

If that all looks right I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed and loop in our Compliance lead if needed.

Thanks — Na

Anna / Na — following up with a short technical checklist so we can size the Private deployment and note blockers early. A few clarifying Qs: 

1) Egress policy: when you say "outbound internet egress allowed" — do you require any outbound traffic to be blocked entirely (no external NTP/DNS), or do you have a whitelist approach for egress destinations? For air‑gapped POCs we need a signed list of allowed destinations.
2) CIDR / peering: can you share the exact CIDR ranges you expect to peer with (we can configure route filters / prefix lists on our side).
3) NAT / SNAT: will your VPC expect us to NAT the traffic or will you provide NAT gateways? For Dedicated on our infra we can support configurable SNAT policies.
4) Auth & SSO: do you require SAML SSO for operator access and MFA for admin accounts? If yes, please share SAML metadata or IdP contact.
5) Key management: are you expecting to bring your own KMS/HSM (BYOK) for encryption at rest, or will you use Redwood‑managed keys?
6) Logging / SIEM: what retention/forwarding do you need — do you require direct ingestion to your SIEM (syslog/HTTPS) or will agents push logs to a collector?

If you can reply inline that will help. I’ll draft a short technical appendix for the HubSpot deal. Marissa — I’ll need the rough estimate of engineering days once we know if peering vs on‑prem appliance is required.
